title: Totally Normal Meat Co.
description:
Bu About This Game:

Welcome to the most questionable fast-food joint you will ever run.

Totally Normal Meat Co. is a persistent idle farming and management simulator that lives at the bottom of your screen. It is designed to be played passively while you focus on other tasks, offering a relaxing yet darkly comedic experience.

Key Features:

Persistent Desktop Integration: Manage your factory in a non-intrusive window that stays on top of your taskbar. Perfect for multitasking during work or study.

Hatch & Evolve: Discover over 4 unique, hand-drawn monster species. Each creature has its own growth rate and "resource yield."

Deep Upgrade System: Invest your profits into factory automation. Upgrade your incubators, automated feeders, and high-speed grinders to scale your production.

Resource Management: Balance your overhead costs with production speed. Keep your livestock "content" just long enough to maximize the quality of your final product.

Unlockable Customization: Earn achievements to unlock new skins for your facility and UI themes to match your desktop aesthetic.

The Goal:

Start with a single pen and a rusty grinder. Work your way up to a fully automated corporate machine. It’s cute, it’s automated, and it’s terribly wrong.
description_short: Raise adorable monsters and process them into profit in this dark-humored idle management sim. Designed as a desktop companion, it runs at the bottom of your screen while you work. Optimize your production line, unlock rare species, and automate your way to a morally questionable empire.
